subject: Nice!

body:
Thanks... this will do great! Its seems fitting now with the name change... SoccerBoi yesterday was asking me why I had the name change since Ive had One Incognito for over 2 years now and the name sounds so close to Chino666...

Well, before Chino played Revenge .. Ive made a tag called Jinno Angelo.. I liked it a lot, so its only fitting that I replace that name because now both my 2 accounts have Angelo in it.... Nero and Jinno...
